- Value for ACME: predictable latency for your customer-facing agents + cost controls (batching/quantization).
- Open items: SOC 2 evidence for procurement review; likely pricing tiers for pilot (100k tokens/mo).

Next steps I suggest:

3) If this looks good, I'll put together an initial Mutual Action Plan / proposed SOW.
